description: Java class GetFilterBsonVisitor that creates MongoDB BSON filters for field-based search criteria, implementing the FilterFieldExpressionVisitor interface and extending AbstractFieldBsonCreator.

classes.name: GetFilterBsonVisitor
classes.description: Creates MongoDB BSON filters for field-based search criteria, implementing the FilterFieldExpressionVisitor interface.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a given expression with a predicate function and optional authorization subject IDs.

methods.name: sudoApply
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a given expression with a predicate function, ignoring authorization restrictions.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for an attribute key.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a feature ID and property.

methods.name: visitPointer
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a pointer string.

methods.name: visitRootLevelField
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a root level field name.

methods.name: matchKeyValue
methods.description: Constructs a BSON filter matching a specific key with optional authorization filtering.
